intro: Datasets and code released by our group. All datasets are available for non-commercial academic research — download the request form on each dataset page, sign it, and email it to rcsong@hfut.edu.cn.

datasets.name: LTHRV
datasets.subtitle: Video-based Pulse, Breathing, and Long-term HRV Analysis Dataset
datasets.description: A multimodal physiological dataset for long-term heart rate variability analysis, containing synchronized RGB video, PPG and respiration signals. Subjects were recorded in a supine position under two conditions: natural breathing, and apnea with timed breath-holds that widen the range of heart rate variability.

facts.label: Reference
facts.value: Contec CMS50EA oximeter + HKH-11C respiration sensor

facts.label: Protocol
facts.value: Natural breathing and apnea, 15 min each

datasets.name: PV3D
datasets.subtitle: Physiological-assisted Visual Deception Detection Dataset
datasets.description: A multimodal deception detection dataset built around a simulated theft scenario, combining video, audio, heart rate, respiration, blood volume pulse and blood oxygen saturation. To our knowledge it is the first dataset that supports video deception detection, remote heart rate measurement and remote respiration measurement at the same time.

facts.label: Video
facts.value: Logitech C920 HD Pro, 30 fps, 640×480, with audio

facts.label: Reference
facts.value: Contec CMS50E oximeter + HKH-11C respiration sensor

datasets.name: BSIPL-motion
datasets.subtitle: Biomedical Signal and Image Processing Laboratory Motion Scenario Dataset
datasets.description: A benchmark for motion-robust remote physiological measurement. Four motion scenarios — speaking, anterior–posterior movement, horizontal movement and random head rotation — are recorded with synchronized reference PPG under two lighting conditions.
